problem.passage:
In the $xy$-plane, line $j$ represents the number of tickets sold, $y$, at a community theater as a function of the ticket price, $x$, in dollars, according to one pricing model. Line $k$ represents the number of tickets sold, $y$, as a function of the ticket price, $x$, according to a second pricing model. The graph shows lines $j$ and $k$.

According to the graph, what is the ticket price, in dollars, at which both pricing models predict the same number of tickets sold?
problem.stimulus: In the $xy$-plane, line $j$ represents the number of tickets sold, $y$, at a community theater as a function of the ticket price, $x$, in dollars, according to one pricing model. Line $k$ represents the number of tickets sold, $y$, as a function of the ticket price, $x$, according to a second pricing model. The graph shows lines $j$ and $k$.
problem.question: According to the graph, what is the ticket price, in dollars, at which both pricing models predict the same number of tickets sold?
problem.explanation:
그래프에서 직선 $j$는 $y = -8x + 90$, 직선 $k$는 $y = -2x + 30$으로 읽을 수 있다. 두 모델이 같은 판매량을 예측하는 지점은 두 직선의 교점이므로 연립방정식을 세운다:
$$\begin{cases} y = -8x + 90 \\ y = -2x + 30 \end{cases}$$
두 식을 같다고 놓으면 $-8x + 90 = -2x + 30$이 되고, 이를 정리하면 $-6x = -60$, 즉 $x = 10$이다. 이때 $y = -2(10) + 30 = 10$이므로 교점은 $(10, 10)$이다. 그래프의 두 직선이 $x = 10$ 부근에서 만나는 것과 일치한다. 문제는 가격(x값)을 묻고 있으므로 정답은 $10$이다.
problem.explanationEn:
From the graph, line $j$ has the equation $y = -8x + 90$ and line $k$ has the equation $y = -2x + 30$. The price at which both models predict the same number of tickets sold corresponds to the intersection point of the two lines, so we solve the system:
$$\begin{cases} y = -8x + 90 \\ y = -2x + 30 \end{cases}$$
Setting the right-hand sides equal: $-8x + 90 = -2x + 30$, which gives $-6x = -60$, so $x = 10$. Substituting back, $y = -2(10) + 30 = 10$, so the intersection point is $(10, 10)$. This matches where the two lines appear to cross on the graph near $x = 10$. Since the question asks for the price (the x-value), the answer is $10$.
